reports.text: [The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/indonesian-vice-president-says-resignation-unrelated-to-scrutiny-of-educational-credentials/) reported that Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka stated his resignation was unrelated to the scrutiny of his educational credentials.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/13/asia-pacific/politics/prabowo-consolidates-power/) reported that Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto has increasingly put his own stamp on the government since taking office.

[The Diplomat](https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/indonesian-vice-president-submits-resignation-amid-school-credentials-controversy/) reported that the controversy is connected to a widening rift between President Prabowo Subianto and his predecessor Joko Widodo.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE1XcTVMMmRlWnlGcXJzVUFKUDRpX0FqTmc3RjFhd2RuUGJOdTFpM2g5dVc0YmlMZUtoWGcxQUdlVU5DdThKWjkxS3ppWW1MM0o4SGNMZlpoWDVqTUlkc29VZkJDdTVTZElJV043RlpsNHNKaENHX2xZRDNZdWU?oc=5), [NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/g-s1-153190/indonesias-vp-resigns-as-his-eligibility-and-academic-credentials-are-questioned), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/13/indonesia-vice-president-diploma-resignation-explained) reported that Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned following questions regarding his academic credentials and eligibility.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-gibran-vice-president-jokowi-prabowo-6541991) reported that analysts stated Gibran's exit as Indonesia's vice president could let President Prabowo further consolidate his influence.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1580374/indonesian-vice-president-gibran-rakabuming-raka-submits-resignation-to-parliament/) reported that Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka formally submitted his resignation to parliament's upper house in Jakarta.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009283/indonesia-vp-hands-resignation-to-parliament-as-dad-jokowi-backs-prabowo/story/) reported that Indonesia VP Gibran Rakabuming Raka handed his resignation to parliament following a push by lawmakers for his impeachment.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmvgxgz87qqro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Indonesia's vice-president resigned amid signs that the ruling alliance with President Prabowo is fraying.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/world/asia/indonesia-gibran-vice-president-resign.html) reported that Gibran Rakabuming Raka stepped down amid a scandal over his academic credentials.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/12/indonesian-vp-resigns-over-education-qualification-row?traffic_source=rss) reported that Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned over a dispute regarding his educational qualifications.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/442051/gibran-resigns-as-vice-president-letter-gives-no-reason-mpr) reported that Indonesia's People's Consultative Assembly Speaker Ahmad Muzani disclosed that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka submitted his resignation letter without giving a reason.
[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441975/gibran-resignation-would-halt-120-lawmaker-impeachment-motion) reported that Gibran's resignation would halt a 120-lawmaker impeachment motion.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3374164/gibran-officially-resigns-indonesias-vice-president-after-degree-scandal) reported that Gibran officially resigned as Indonesia's vice-president following a scandal over his high school diploma.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxPOTZ0Q3FKQkpsRnZBSlJKMHFqS3d1QV9qTXp5aUpidXh5eEF3amd5aWh0YUFfbnJHYVQ4c29LaVRQTDJKbkRiUHBuTERNU1RuRnJ4dlFGdlY2ZWJIYjN1RmRQeUF6bkNITTFjQ2tUWlpUQWJqd3ZFQ1FOSnR4MkRzSm5uaDVoSjlOZVgwUHRkX1JCVTItVE1NUnVIQjZxcTd0N3V2NDUxSm9aUldEUWZQeVB6WGIxT0lQTE5QY2F4SG9PaTgxRGZkcnNB?oc=5) reported that over 100 Indonesian lawmakers signed a petition demanding the vice president's impeachment.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441795/all-house-factions-submit-proposal-to-impeach-vp-gibran) reported that all political party factions in Indonesia's House of Representatives submitted a formal Right to Express proposal to impeach Vice President Gibran.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-petition-vp-gibran-rakabuming-raka-impeachment-6542386) reported that over 100 Indonesian lawmakers signed a petition stating that Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka no longer meets the requirements of his post.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3374034/indonesian-vp-resignation-drama-raises-stakes-prabowo-alliances-strain) reported that the prospect of Gibran Rakabuming Raka stepping down as Indonesia's vice-president has raised the stakes for President Prabowo Subianto.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441679/govt-assures-no-vice-presidential-vacancy-yusril) reported that Coordinating Minister for Law, Human Rights, Immigration and Correctional Affairs Yusril Ihza Mahendra assured there is no vice presidential vacancy.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441647/gibran-joins-prabowo-at-palace-after-expressing-intention-to-resign) reported that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka attended a National Heroes Day award ceremony at the State Palace after expressing his intention to resign.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441639/gibran-seeks-chance-to-prove-validity-of-diploma-through-court-process) reported that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka asked President Prabowo Subianto for an opportunity to prove the validity of his diploma through court.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441607/palace-respects-parliament-inquiry-push-into-vps-diploma) reported that the Indonesian Presidential Palace stated it respects the parliamentary political process concerning an inquiry into the Vice President's diploma.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441583/palace-confirms-gibrans-intention-to-resign-from-vice-presidency) reported that State Secretary Minister Prasetyo Hadi confirmed Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka expressed his intention to resign from the vice presidency.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3373961/indonesian-vp-gibrans-fate-hangs-balance-parliament-ponders-probe) reported that Indonesia's parliament reconvened with lawmakers weighing a probe into the eligibility of Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-vice-president-gibran-rakabuming-raka-intention-step-down-6538841) reported that Indonesian VP Gibran expressed intent to step down, while a presidential spokesperson denied reports that President Prabowo Subianto rejected the request.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-politicians-psi-ministers-joko-widodo-son-6538586) reported that three politicians in Prabowo's Cabinet resigned from the party led by Jokowi's son.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/10/asia-pacific/politics/indonesia-vice-president-probe/) reported that the fate of Indonesia's vice president hangs in the balance as lawmakers mull a probe amid a political rift between his father and President Prabowo Subianto.

reports.text: [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/entrega-jefe-juridico-banco-central-paraguay-investigado-caida-ueno-bank_1794790896) reported that Aldo Rodríguez, head of the legal department of the Central Bank of Paraguay, surrendered to a police station in Asunción after an arrest warrant was issued over an altered report in the Ueno Bank case.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/asi-vive-la-principal-plaza-de-mercado-de-asuncion-la-crisis-financiera-por-la-caida-de-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-3600940) reported that sellers at Mercado 4 in Asunción stated sales have plummeted due to the Ueno Bank financial crisis.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/la-caida-del-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-revela-el-avance-de-los-tecnomagnates-en-america-latina-nid14112026/) reported that the crisis of Paraguay's digital bank exposed links between technology entrepreneurs, governments, and far-right financing networks.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/fiscalia-paraguaya-acusa-asociacion-criminal-pena-cupula-bcp-caso-ueno-bank_1794677588) reported that Paraguayan prosecutor Christian Benítez stated a new charge of criminal association has been added against former president Santiago Peña and the Central Bank leadership in the Ueno bank case.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/how-a-bank-collapse-in-paraguay-brought-down-the-countrys-president-explained/article71677767.ece) reported that millions of customers abruptly lost access to savings and pension accounts after regulators seized a bank in Paraguay.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-pena-criminal-association-ueno/), a state-media outlet, reported that Paraguay's Public Prosecutor's Office added a charge of criminal association as perpetrator against former president Santiago Peña.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/fiscalia-acusa-expresidente-paraguayo-pena-de-liderar-una-asociacion-criminal) reported that the prosecutor's office accused former Paraguayan president Peña of leading a criminal association, which carries a sentence of up to 15 years in prison.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/milei-se-comunico-con-pedro-alliana-el-sucesor-de-santiago-pena-en-paraguay-nid13112026/) reported that Javier Milei communicated with Pedro Alliana, the successor of Santiago Peña, and expressed readiness to collaborate.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/crisis-en-paraguay-fiscalia-pide-ampliar-la-imputacion-contra-el-expresidente-santiago-pena-y-lo-acusa-de-liderar-una-asociacion-criminal-3600892), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/la-fiscalia-de-paraguay-complica-la-situacion-de-pena-con-una-nueva-imputacion-por-asociacion-nid13112026/), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/fiscalia-acusa-a-expresidente-paraguayo-de-liderar-asociacion-criminal-santiago-pena-protegio-desde-el-poder-a-ueno-bank-senala/) reported that the Paraguayan prosecutor's office expanded charges against former president Santiago Peña, accusing him of leading a criminal association and protecting Ueno Bank from power.

[Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/santiago-pena-palacios-presidente-de-paraguay-sigue-la-pauta-destituido-y-en-la-carcel/) reported that regulators seized Ueno Bank, which managed about 850 million dollars in public funds.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/paraguay-adds-prosecutors-ueno-bank-pena-investigations/) reported that Paraguay's attorney general Emiliano Rolón added two prosecutors to the Ueno Bank and Santiago Peña investigations.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fiscalia-de-paraguay-allana-la-residencia-presidencial-por-escandalo-de-ueno-bank-33098347) reported that the Paraguayan justice system is carrying out two parallel investigations, one focused on Ueno Bank executives, 10 of whom are detained.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/paraguay-detienen-al-superintendente-de-bancos-por-caso-ueno-bank) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks was detained in connection with the Ueno Bank case following reports by prosecutors regarding operations without guarantees.

[MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/12/paraguay-s-banking-superintendent-arrested-in-the-ueno-bank-investigation?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/caso-ueno-bank-detuvieron-superintendente-bancos-paraguay_0_haEsfgaxKm.html) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks, Holger Insfrán, was arrested as part of the investigation into Ueno Bank.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/ahorristas-bolivianos-ueno-bank-pueden-perder-12-dinero-tipo-cambio_1794364395) reported that Sergio León, director of the Bolivian-Paraguayan Chamber of Commerce, stated that Bolivian depositors in Ueno Bank can lose between up to 12% of their money due to the exchange rate.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/seguridad-social-paraguay-denuncia-ueno-bank-516-millones-dolares_1794351537) reported that Paraguay's social security denounced Ueno Bank for more than 516 million dollars, with President Pedro Alliana confirming the return of funds to public sector contributors.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/gobernante-partido-colorado-expulsa-santiago-pena-escandalo-ueno-bank_1794351056) reported that the ruling Colorado Party expelled Santiago Peña after the Ueno bank scandal.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/video-explica-crise-politica-e-bancaria-que-abala-o-paraguai-e-derrubou-presidente.shtml) reported that Paraguay is facing a political and financial crisis following the collapse of Ueno Bank, which left approximately 3 million clients affected.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/banco-central-revela-que-devolvio-ahorros-al-93-de-los-clientes-de-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-investigacion-continua/) reported that the Central Bank of Paraguay announced it returned savings to 93 percent of Ueno Bank clients while investigations continue.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/caso-ueno-deja-7-senales-alerta-vigilar-salud-bancos_1794326171) reported that banking expert Fabián Chaín warned that the Ueno case leaves seven warning signs to monitor the health of banks.

reports.text: [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr894w453e90o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that schools across Italy received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking evacuations.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovi-allarmi-bomba-in-3.800-scuole-ma-si-resta-in-classe_8e554317-0de6-4431-82f1-76e9da9afb9d.html) reported that new bomb alarms hit 3,800 schools in Italy while classes continued.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxQSFJJaFJoR2JHVWdTZmVzdkw2MDhTc29qU0pDRmdmaXpwWjN2Q3VyYjlFUWJkRmJHTmlaNFFYdWIxdTFHR3p5VGlTaGExYzFwZ3BTRjV6dTJuQWdibllJN1lwd3E1RThuUEU2ekpfbU1GSUJwU2tyMkd5a3daSEkwNm5YU19zUEIxLWpSNjNDS0lzT1NCd2ZQRG1COA?oc=5), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/italian-schools-hit-by-fresh-bomb-threats-premiers-office-targeted-3725511) reported that Italian schools remained open despite a fresh wave of email bomb threats that led to evacuations and security inspections in several regions.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/12/italy-hit-by-second-day-of-school-bomb-threats-as-meloni-summons-opposition) reported that bomb threats hit schools in Italy and France, and French President Emmanuel Macron stated it is too soon to blame foreign powers.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/politica/2026/11/12/nel-pomeriggio-riunione-tecnica-sul-protocollo-di-gestione-degli-allarmi_935b5bfb-8d1b-47fb-b1f5-5bec809755af.html) reported that an official circular was issued to schools stating that evacuations should not occur in the absence of concrete dangers, while prefects retain the authority to order them.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovo-allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-controlli-e-evacuazioni-liveblog_97a3c6b7-93f4-44a2-940b-dd33198f2f91.html) reported that a new bomb alarm hit schools across various regions via emails signed by Mikhail Andropov.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-hybrid-warfare-hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-to-schools-in-italy-uk-in-latest-disruption) reported that hoax bomb alerts were sent to schools in Italy and the UK.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-thousands-of-schools-evacuated-in-italy-as-bomb-threats-spread-across-europe) reported that thousands of schools were evacuated across Italy following a series of hoax bomb threats.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-schools-italy-uk-and-ireland-latest-disruption) reported that schools across Italy were evacuated after around 6,300 of them received bomb warnings.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/hoax-bomb-threats-target-italys-schools-with-over-300-evacuated) reported that Italian authorities evacuated hundreds of schools following a bomb threat sent via email.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/11/les-ecoles-italiennes-irlandaises-et-ecossaises-visees-par-des-alertes-a-la-bombe_6809033_3210.html) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland received threatening emails.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/videogallery/italia/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-italiane-evacuazioni-a-roma-milano-liguria-e-venezia_7aa42fc1-bbfb-4057-a24a-320286389ef8.html) reported bomb alarms across Italian schools with evacuations in Rome, Milan, Liguria, and Venice.

[Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/11/11/tysiachi-shkol-v-italii-velikobritanii-i-irlandii-poluchili-soobshcheniia-s-ugrozami-vzryva-news) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Great Britain, and Ireland received false bomb threat messages.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/centenas-de-escolas-na-italia-irlanda-do-norte-e-escocia-recebem-ameacas-de-bomba-alunos-sao-retirados.shtml) reported that hundreds of schools across Italy received bomb threats by email.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/amenazas-falsas-de-bomba-siguen-alertando-a-europa-italia-irlanda-y-reino-unido-desalojan-escuelas-ante-presuntas-amenazas-3600148) reported that false bomb threats also alerted schools in the UK and Ireland, prompting evacuations.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-in-oltre-6000-scuole-in-italia-evacuazioni-e-controlli.-meloni-grande_870b0024-72d2-4b15-bab5-0c74dcc1d653.html) reported that false bomb threats sent via an anonymous email led to evacuations and controls in over 6,000 schools in Italy.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/threatening-hoax-messages-sent-hundreds-schools-italy-uk-ireland.1136937) reported that threatening hoax messages were sent to hundreds of schools in Italy, the UK, and Ireland.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwz0k79pr8z2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that false warnings containing bomb threats were sent via email to schools in Rome, Naples, Vicenza, Florence, Pisa, Trieste, and other Italian cities.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/giorgia-meloni-italian-milan-antonio-tajani-rome-b3083120.html) reported that Italian authorities evacuated around 300 schools after receiving bomb threats via email.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3374103/over-300-italian-schools-evacuated-after-receiving-same-emailed-bomb-alert) reported that at least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated after receiving the same bomb alert message.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/bomb-threat-emails-trigger-evacuation-of-300-schools-across-italy-101794396853871.html) reported that bomb threat emails triggered the evacuation of 300 schools across Italy amid rising concerns over hybrid warfare threats.
[24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23911182) reported that around 300 schools in Italy received bomb threats sent via email.

[De Telegraaf](https://www.telegraaf.nl/buitenland/bommeldingen-op-honderden-scholen-in-italie-ierland-en-schotland/164394527.html) reported that hundreds of schools were evacuated in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland following anonymous bomb threat emails.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/vuelven-evacuar-cientos-escuelas-italia-falsas-amenazas-bomba-segunda-vez-mes_0_7GXzyxNE7g.html) reported that hundreds of schools in Italy were evacuated for the second time in less than a month following anonymous emails containing bomb threats directed at principals.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/11/pais-correm-para-buscar-filhos-apos-ameacas-de-bomba-em-ao-menos-312-escolas-na-italia-governo-descarta-perigo-iminente.ghtml) reported that at least 312 institutions were affected by the sequence of bomb threats against Italian schools, causing anxiety among parents.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914575) reported that at least 300 Italian schools were evacuated after receiving email bomb alerts signed by Mikhail Andropov.

[Echorouk](https://www.echoroukonline.com/%d8%a5%d9%8a%d8%b7%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%8a%d8%a7-%d8%a5%d8%ae%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%a1-%d8%a3%d9%83%d8%ab%d8%b1-%d9%85%d9%86-300-%d9%85%d8%af%d8%b1%d8%b3%d8%a9-%d8%a8%d8%b3%d8%a8%d8%a8-%d8%b1%d8%b3%d8%a7%d8%a6) reported that at least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated after receiving identical emails warning of bombs inside educational institutions.

reports.text: [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062953/) reported that Ukraine's General Staff stated a strike on Russia's Akhtubinsk airfield caused a secondary detonation at a missile kit depot and hit a drone launch site in Oryol Oblast.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-reportedly-strikes-russian-military-airfield-in-astrakhan-oblast-at-least-30-explosions-heard/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90164) reported that long-range strike drones hit the Akhtubinsk military airfield in Russia's Astrakhan region overnight, triggering at least 30 explosions.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-war-latest-russia-launches-mass-attack-on-odesa-oblast-as-ukraine-strikes-airfield-drone-launch-site-in-russia/) reported that Ukraine struck a Russian military airfield in Astrakhan Oblast and a drone launch site in Oryol Oblast, while Russia launched a mass attack on Odesa Oblast.

[TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2218367), a Russian state-owned outlet, reported that a woman and a man were hospitalized with shrapnel wounds after Ukrainian drone attacks in the Belgorod Region.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261115-ukrainian-drones-strike-russia-s-petrochemical-capital-in-overnight-assault) reported that Russian officials confirmed Nizhnekamsk endured prolonged Ukrainian airstrikes overnight that damaged a residential building.
[TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2218349) reported that three civilians were wounded in a Ukrainian drone attack on their car in the Bryansk Region.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-war-live-donbas-nato-trump-putin-zelensky-b3085186.html) reported that a Kyiv drone strike sparked a fire at a Russian petrochemical plant and hit a defense and aviation manufacturing plant in the Bryansk region.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062944/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90172), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184855-ukrainian-forces-strike-two-plants-in-tatarstan-helicopter-manufacturer-in-bryansk-region.html) reported that Ukrainian forces also struck the Monolit helicopter manufacturing facility in the Bryansk region.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184803-russian-attacks-leave-14-injured-in-kharkiv-region-damage-businesses-warehouses-and-homes.html) reported that Russian attacks in the Kharkiv region injured 14 people, including four children, and damaged businesses, warehouses, and homes.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184822-russian-drone-attacks-damage-property-in-five-districts-of-kyiv-region-one-person-injured.html) reported that Russian drone attacks caused property damage across five districts of the Kyiv region and injured one person.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184802-petrochemical-plant-on-fire-in-tatarstan-following-drone-attack-substation-damaged-in-taganrog-media.html), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90156) reported that long-range drones struck the Nizhnekamskneftekhim petrochemical complex in Russia's Republic of Tatarstan overnight, causing a fire.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062931/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90157), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184809-russian-attack-on-chornomorsk-leaves-six-injured-damages-energy-infrastructure.html) reported that a Russian attack on Chornomorsk injured six people and damaged energy and civilian infrastructure.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184808-russian-forces-strike-energy-infrastructure-in-zhytomyr-region.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062933/) reported that Russian drone strikes damaged energy infrastructure in the Zhytomyr region.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184798-russian-forces-attack-industrial-facility-in-kirovohrad-region-causing-fires.html) reported that Russian forces attacked an industrial infrastructure facility in the Kirovohrad region, causing fires to break out.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062911/) reported that a drone attack on Nizhnekamsk in Russia's Tatarstan caused a major fire at the Nizhnekamskneftekhim petrochemical plant.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/drone-attack-kills-1-injures-4-in-russias-rostov-oblast-governor-says/) reported that a drone attack killed one person and injured four others in Rostov Oblast, damaging two electrical substations in Taganrog.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184780-russians-shell-dnipropetrovsk-region-more-than-10-times-since-evening-damaging-homes-transport-infrastructure.html) reported that Russian shelling of the Dnipropetrovsk region damaged residential buildings, a store, and transport infrastructure.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062905/) reported that Russian guided aerial bombs struck Zaporizhzhia, damaging apartment blocks and dozens of cars, causing a fire and injuring six people.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90149) reported that Russian tactical aviation launched 12 guided aerial bomb strikes against Zaporizhzhia.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/fire-reported-at-industrial-facility-in-russias-tatarstan-amid-drone-attack/) reported a fire at an industrial facility in Russia's Tatarstan amid a drone attack.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184752-russian-attack-on-zaporizhzhia-leaves-five-injured.html) reported that a Russian attack on the Voznesenivskyi district of Zaporizhzhia injured at least five people.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184613-russian-forces-attack-energy-facility-in-odesa-region-nearly-50000-consumers-left-without-power.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062851/) reported that nearly 50,000 consumers in the Odesa region remain without electricity following a Russian strike on a DTEK energy facility.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184687-russian-drones-attack-naftogaz-facility-in-poltava-region.html) reported that Russian drones attacked a Naftogaz Group facility in the Poltava region, causing a fire.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184727-russian-attacks-on-dnipropetrovsk-region-leave-one-killed-13-injured.html) reported that Russian forces launched nearly 30 attacks using drones, artillery, and a missile across four districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region, leaving one person killed and 13 injured.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062885/) reported that a Russian drone strike caused a large fire at a Naftogaz facility in Poltava Oblast, and another attack killed two men in Chernihiv Oblast.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxNeW5QSkVpZ1BJcFBDZ25uWTdpOVN0X2xQYnlUZjNncFo3N0x2QmtRekFuTlFjVDhfUnF0dTRsc1BfVE9uYUYtSVl3T2RDckdadm12OHM0aWdwXzJQaWQzLUpzZDAtTm4yUmRrcVFoVWRabV92M1JGbkxSRkt4U2ZtX3BNVkw1RXdjaGswa3k5TWZaVTA?oc=5) reported that Russian strikes killed one person in Zaporizhzhia and two in Odesa.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184725-russian-forces-attack-critical-infrastructure-facility-in-chernihiv-region-two-killed-one-injured.html) reported that Russian forces attacked a critical infrastructure facility in Mena in the Chernihiv region, killing two men and injuring another person.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184703-russians-launch-missile-strike-on-pavlohrad-leaving-three-injured.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062874/) reported that a Russian missile strike on Pavlohrad killed one person and injured several others.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062868/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90138) reported that Russian drone and artillery strikes killed a civilian and wounded multiple people in Zaporizhzhia Oblast.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062860/) reported that police officers in Sumy Oblast rescued a 54-year-old woman and her nine-year-old grandson after a Russian attack caused a fire at their home.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184658-ssu-drones-strike-oil-facility-in-russia39s-samara-region.html) reported that SSU long-range drones struck an oil facility in Russia's Samara region.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/at-least-7-killed-80-injured-in-russian-attacks-across-ukraine-zaporizhzhia-among-worst-hit/) reported that at least 7 people were killed and 80 injured in Russian attacks across Ukraine.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90126) reported that Russian drone attacks struck residential neighborhoods in Derhachi in the Kharkiv region and Hlukhiv in the Sumy region.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90110) reported that Russia's Buyan-M-class missile ship Naro-Fominsk sustained multiple drone hits in the Baltic Sea resulting in crew casualties.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062834/) reported that Russian strikes across three Ukrainian oblasts over the past day killed three people and injured seven others.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184591-three-killed-62-injured-in-russian-attacks-on-zaporizhzhia-region-over-past-day.html) reported that Russian forces launched nearly 884 attacks on the Zaporizhzhia region, killing three people including a child and injuring 62 others.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184592-two-killed-five-injured-in-russian-attacks-on-kherson-region-over-past-day.html) reported that Russian forces killed two people and injured five others in the Kherson region.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184479-russian-strike-on-zaporizhzhia-injury-toll-rises-to-50-including-eight-children.html) reported that the injury toll from a Russian strike in the Kosmichnyi district of Zaporizhzhia rose to 50, including eight children.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90047) reported that Ukraine's General Staff stated the Navy's Neptune coastal missile system struck three drone-related sites in Rostov-on-Don.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90049) reported that Russian attacks on Zaporizhzhia killed two people and injured at least 50, including eight children.

reports.text: [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/16/spacex-blames-technical-issue-for-starlink-speed-restrictions-in-ukraine) reported that Denys Sienik stated SpaceX attributed Starlink speed restrictions in Ukraine to a technical issue.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/16/u-s-senators-demand-musk-preserve-records-on-starlink-restrictions-in-ukraine-ahead-of-planned-investigation) reported that US Democratic senators Jeanne Shaheen and Chris Coons demanded that SpaceX founder Elon Musk preserve all documents related to restrictions on Ukraine's use of Starlink.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/16/ukraine-war-briefing-energy-attacks-made-possible-by-continuing-starshield-restrictions-says-zelenskyy) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reiterated that continued restrictions on Elon Musk's Starshield service have enabled Russian energy attacks.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/volodymyr-zelensky-says-starshield-restrictions-threaten-ukraine-s-energy-defenses-ahead-of-winter-russia-ukraine-war-us-ceasefire-101794791954503.html) reported that a Russian strike on Chornomorsk in Ukraine's Odesa region injured six people and damaged energy infrastructure.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/bbc/zelensky-pide-ee-uu-elon-musk-reestablecer-acceso-total-ucrania-starlink-frenar-ataques-rusos_1794771072) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky asked the U.S. and Elon Musk to restore full access to Starlink to halt Russian attacks.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/zelenskyy-urges-removal-of-starshield-limits-on-ukraine/a-79953300?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Ukraine's government stated satellite internet throttling prevents Kyiv from intercepting Russian attacks.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/zelensky-reporta-nuevos-problemas-con-starshield-ucrania-pierde-capacidad-para-frenar-drones-rusos/) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Starshield limitations weaken defenses around energy infrastructure and reduce Ukraine's ability to stop Russian drones.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/zelenskyy-says-starshield-restrictions-threaten-ukraines-energy-defenses-ahead-of-winter) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Starshield restrictions appear to have been imposed by SpaceX despite earlier assurances from US Secretary of State Marco Rubio.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/russia-central-asia/article/3374516/zelensky-says-starshield-restrictions-threaten-ukraines-energy-defences-ahead-winter) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated restrictions on Starshield are hindering Ukraine's ability to intercept Russian drones and threatening winter energy defences.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184851-many-drone-strikes-on-substations-get-through-due-to-starshield-speed-restrictions-zelensky.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated many Russian Shahed-type drone strikes on substations get through because speed restrictions remain in place for Starshield terminals along the frontline.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062949/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Starshield terminals cut off interceptor drones at 161 km/h, preventing them from catching jet-powered Shaheds.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/zelenskyy-says-russias-energy-attacks-helped-by-starshield-restrictions/article71704646.ece) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Russia struck energy and railway infrastructure in eight regions overnight with many strikes penetrating defenses due to Starshield limits.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/15/zelenskyy-questions-spacex-over-reported-starshield-speed-restrictions) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Starshield speed restrictions directly affect Ukraine's ability to intercept Russian jet-powered attack drones.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-war-live-trump-putin-zelensky-starship-b3085121.html) reported that Kyiv stated restrictions on military-grade Starshield terminals have left Ukrainian forces less able to intercept Russian jet-powered drones.

[RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/ukraine-starshield-spacex-russia-missile-airstrikes/33898879.html) reported that Ukraine stated restrictions affecting its use of SpaceX’s Starshield satellite communications system remain widespread, hampering military drone defenses.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4184601-democrats-urge-musk-to-preserve-records-on-starlink-operations-in-ukraine-media.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062840/) reported that Democratic senators on the Senate Foreign Relations Committee asked SpaceX CEO Elon Musk to preserve all documents and communications regarding Starlink operations and restrictions in Ukraine.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/democratic-us-senators-order-musk-to-preserve-records-on-ukraine-starlink-access/article71700765.ece), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90093), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/united-states-canada/article/3374425/musk-ordered-preserve-records-ukraines-starlink-access-democratic-us-senators) reported that Democratic U.S. senators ordered Elon Musk to preserve all records concerning SpaceX's restrictions on Ukraine's access to Starlink and Starshield systems by November 30.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/us-democrats-direct-musk-to-preserve-records-on-ukraines-starlink-restriction-wsj-reports/) reported that U.S. Democrats stated the October and November restrictions raise the possibility that vulnerabilities persist within systems used by the U.S. government.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/14/world/europe/ukraine-starshield-zelensky.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated the system used to guide drones was being throttled over Russian-occupied territory.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/14/spacex-not-honest-slowing-starshield-elon-musk-volodymyr-zelenskyy) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy accused SpaceX of dishonesty regarding political reasons for slowing Starshield.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-war-live-trump-putin-zelensky-spacex-starshield-b3084909.html) reported that Moscow struck a hospital in central Kyiv.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/14/ukraine-war-briefing-zelenskyy-says-starshield-restrictions-continue-on-entire-front-line) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Starshield restrictions continue on the entire front line.

[NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/nx-s1-6038809/us-envoys-meet-putin-russia-ukraine-war-talks), [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-13/Putin-US-envoys-discuss-Ukraine-talks-as-positions-remain-divided-1S24FlpboIw/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in the Kremlin to discuss Ukraine talks.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90089) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated US-operated Starshield restrictions remain in place, limiting Ukraine's ability to intercept Russian drones.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/89977) reported that US Senators Jeanne Shaheen and Thom Tillis demanded that the Trump administration and SpaceX immediately restore Ukraine's Starshield satellite access.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/13/8062691/) reported that a bipartisan group of 105 House members asked the administration and SpaceX to explain why Starshield was restricted.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2217901), a Russian state outlet, reported that Volodymyr Zelensky stated the US side offered no explanation for continued Starshield restrictions for Ukraine.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-seeks-explanation-on-starshield-speed-restrictions-from-us/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated the Starshield speed restrictions applied over Russian-occupied territory and along the front line.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/12/war-in-ukraine-putin-meets-with-envoys-from-the-us-president/) Africanews reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned European leaders against discussions between the United States and Russia.

reports.text: [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/papa-leon-xiv-en-peru-en-vivo-las-ultimas-actividades-antes-del-fin-del-viaje-minuto-a-minuto-nid16112026/) reported that Pope Leo XIV continued his agenda on the final day of his South American tour with a visit and a mass before departure from Cal Airdrome.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/papa-leon-xiv-regresa-a-lima-para-culminar-su-gira-por-latinoamerica-33154320) reported that a mass will serve as the finale for Pope Leo XIV's visit to Peru and his first tour of Latin America.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/leon-xiv-llama-oir-el-grito-de-la-tierra-en-la-amazonia-de-peru) reported that Pope Leo XIV called to hear the cry of the earth in the Peruvian Amazon after flying from Cusco to Pucallpa.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/en-el-cierre-de-un-dia-extenuante-leon-xiv-denuncio-la-devastacion-de-la-amazonia-y-reclamo-justicia-nid15112026/), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/16/pope-leo-speech-peru-justice-for-amazon-activists-environment) reported that Pope Leo XIV condemned the devastation of the Amazon, deforestation, illegal mining, pollution, and drug trafficking, and demanded justice for indigenous populations and environmental defenders.

[MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/16/leo-xiv-rides-in-a-peruvian-military-helicopter-cockpit-and-reaches-cusco?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Pope Leo XIV shared the cockpit with Peruvian Air Force pilots during a helicopter journey to Cusco.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/1088234/papa-lav-xiv-predvodio-misu-na-3-700-metara-nadmorske-visine) reported that Pope Leo XIV led a mass at 3,700 meters above sea level attended by tens of thousands of people.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/svijet/papa-predvodio-misu-na-3-700-metara-hiljade-vjernika-stigle-do-drevne-utvrde/) reported that thousands of believers reached an ancient fortress where the Pope led a mass at 3,700 meters.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/actualite-france/en-amazonie-leon-xiv-denonce-l-abandon-des-populations-autochtones-et-lance-une-alerte-pour-la-preservation-de-la-nature-20261116) reported that Pope Leo XIV travelled from Cusco to Pucallpa in the Peruvian Amazon, where he denounced the abandonment of indigenous populations.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/pope-leo-heads-to-the-amazon-on-the-final-leg-of-his-south-american-tour/a-79952884?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Pope Leo XIV headed to the Amazon on the final leg of his South American tour, where he warned that deforestation, illegal mining, and pollution threaten the Amazon and demanded justice for environmental defenders.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/vaticano/notizie/2026/11/15/il-papa-a-cusco-langelus-a-3mila-metri-dopo-loperazione-_9a8adf03-7d7d-4158-b2d8-3ccd37cc5021.html) reported that Pope Leo XIV visited Cusco and held the Angelus at 3,000 meters altitude.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/pope-leo-south-america-tour-amazon-rainforest-b3085327.html) reported that Pope Leo XIV demanded justice for environmental defenders killed while protecting the Amazon.

[Rzeczpospolita](https://www.rp.pl/kosciol/art45491531-leon-xiv-w-andach-papiez-zwrocil-sie-do-chorych-i-mieszkancow-peru) reported that Pope Leo XIV visited Cusco, met with thousands of faithful, and prayed in front of the cathedral.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/c6pw4rl00lrjo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/gallery/2026/11/15/photos-pope-leo-visits-perus-amazon-and-andean-regions-during-12-day-tour?traffic_source=rss) reported that Pope Leo XIV rode in a helicopter cockpit during his Latin America tour before arriving in Cusco and called for the preservation of Indigenous traditions.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/papa-leon-xiv-denuncia-explotacion-de-la-amazonia-exige-justicia-para-pueblos-indigenas/), [El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/papa-leon-xiv-denuncia-peru-explotacion-amazonia-asesinato-lideres-indigenas_1794779867), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/leon-xiv-amazonia-peruana-sangre-lideres-indigenas-asesinados-reclama-justicia_0_GdZENt173K.html) reported that Pope Leo XIV denounced the exploitation of the Amazon, the assassination of Indigenous leaders, and demanded justice during his visit to Peru.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/el-papa-leon-xiv-ante-mas-de-medio-millon-de-fieles-en-cusco-en-la-etapa-mas-desafiante-de-su-gira-a-nid15112026/) reported that Pope Leo XIV addressed over half a million faithful in Cusco at the end of his Latin American tour.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/15/papa-leao-xiv-acompanha-voo-na-cabine-de-helicoptero-militar-durante-visita-aos-andes-veja-video.ghtml) reported that Pope Leo XIV observed part of a helicopter flight over the Andes mountain range from the cockpit.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/papa-llega-cusco-un-mes-despues-de-su-operacion) reported that Pope Leo XIV arrived in Cusco one month after his surgery and met with faithful and popular religious representatives.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/mundo-e-ciencia/2026/11/7322610-papa-chega-a-cusco-a-3-400-metros-de-altitude-um-mes-apos-cirurgia.html) reported that Pope Leo XIV will visit Indigenous people in the Peruvian Amazon and historical regions in the Andes.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/african-union-warns-drc-ebola-could-cause-a-large-continental-outbreak/) reported that Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention Director-General Jean Kaseya warned that the humanitarian crisis and insecurity could cause a large continental Ebola outbreak.

[Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-15-africa-cdc-says-ebola-outbreak-still-out-of-control-six-months-since-it-was/) reported that the Africa CDC stated the Ebola outbreak in Congo remains out of control six months after being declared.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ebola-outbreak-kills-over-5400-in-dr-congo-as-conflict-hampers-response/) reported that over 5,400 people died in an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/health/health-news/925381-ebola-drc-cases-surpass-11000-insecurity-hampers-response.html) reported that according to the WHO, an armed attack in Cantine-Aloya killed 66 civilians including three health workers and looted three health facilities.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/podcasts/invit%C3%A9-international/20261115-ebola-l-absence-de-vaccin-explique-l-ampleur-de-cette-%C3%A9pid%C3%A9mie-dit-jean-kaseya-africa-cdc) reported that Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya stated the lack of vaccines explains the scale of the epidemic.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/ebola-outbreak-remains-out-of-control-in-congo-six-months-into-response/article71704179.ece) reported that the Ebola outbreak in Congo is the deadliest of the country's 17 outbreaks and remains out of control six months into the response.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/congo-ebola-outbreak-claims-nearly-half-of-infected-as-cases-cross-11000/articleshow/135849071.cms) reported that the outbreak has resulted in over 11,000 cases with high fatalities and inadequate basic health measures.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uae/2026/11/15/ebola-outbreak-not-under-control-amid-dysfunctions-in-response-msf-warns/) reported that MSF warned the Ebola outbreak is not under control due to response dysfunctions.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE9GUWp5OWp5ZzEyOERaTnRzZ1kyQjRvOVkzR1FoNWxQUEwyY2NoM3JyOXB0LWJEQlBVVk92R2JST2VYaWQ0MjFzVm1tLUFvdHdJcXM2N3dac0JWd05namhJRmtuRFVzZFplTl9yNzF1RFp3RHZV?oc=5) reported that the UN hailed progress in the Ebola response while citing insecurity as the biggest challenge.

[The East African](https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/sustainability/ebola-insecurity-in-eastern-drc-blocks-response-5668350) reported that insecurity in eastern DRC is blocking the Ebola response as deaths pass 5,300.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/africa/ebola-spreads-into-rural-areas-of-drc-as-violence-hampers-response) reported that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading into remote rural communities.

[UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168797), [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611130262.html) reported that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread amid repeated attacks on civilians and frontline health workers.

[Nation (Kenya)](https://nation.africa/kenya/news/africa/attacks-on-health-workers-hamper-congo-ebola-fight-africa-cdc-warns-5669136) reported that the Africa CDC warned attacks on health workers are hampering the Ebola fight in Congo following an armed group attack in North Kivu that killed 66 people.

[The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/14/2027-centre-condemns-politically-motivated-violence-in-nigeria/) reported that the Centre for Social Justice, Equity and Transparency strongly condemned the rising wave of politically motivated violence in Nigeria ahead of 2027.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/wike-condemns-obi-over-national-anthem-questions-his-loyalty-to-nigeria/) reported that FCT Minister Nyesom Wike criticized Peter Obi over the national anthem and questioned his loyalty to Nigeria.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/2027-obis-refusal-to-honour-national-anthem-threatens-national-unity-wike/), [Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/peter-obi-out-to-divide-nigeria-lawless-for-snubbing-national-anthem-wike/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-wike-questions-obis-patriotism-over-anthem/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Federal Capital Territory Minister Nyesom Wike questioned Peter Obi's patriotism after the NDC candidate allegedly refused to stand for the national anthem at a party event.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/lagos-ndc-attack-amnesty-cautions-against-brutal-campaign-of-repression-against-opposition/) reported that Amnesty International condemned the violent attack by suspected political thugs on members and supporters of the Nigeria Democratic Congress.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/924935-enugu-govt-speaks-on-alleged-blocking-of-peter-obi-ndc-from-using-campaign-venue.html) reported that the Enugu government spoke regarding allegations that Governor Peter Mbah directed the Chairperson of the Enugu State Tourism Board to deny Peter Obi and the NDC the use of a campaign venue.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/attack-on-ndc-supporters-in-lagos-cowardly-ladipo-johnson/) reported that Ladipo Johnson described the attack on NDC supporters in Lagos as cowardly and stated that the incident should not be regarded as a feud between political groups.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/we-wont-jump-to-conclusions-over-ndc-attack-lagos-apc/) reported that the Lagos APC urged Nigerians not to overlook threats by opposition parties to unleash mayhem.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/12/peter-obi-supporters-and-journalists-attacked-at-campaign-event-in-nigeria/) reported that violence broke out in Lagos as Nigeria Democratic Congress members gathered for a town hall meeting, forcing participants to flee.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/obi-leads-ndc-supporters-in-singing-old-national-anthem-in-lagos/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741140-moment-peter-obi-reject-constitutionally-approve-national-anthem/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/omokri-knocks-obi-supporters-for-reciting-old-national-anthem/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Peter Obi alongside governorship candidate Funso Doherty and other attendees declined to stand for the current national anthem and recited the old national anthem at a town hall meeting in Lagos.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/morning-recap-inec-fixes-mock-poll-date-police-probe-obi-town-hall-attack-other-top-stories/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the police are probing the town hall attack on Peter Obi's supporters.
[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/thugs-attack-ndc-supporters-in-lagos/) reported that a police source stated the organizers did not inform security agencies of their rally.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/lagos-2027-thugs-disrupt-ndc-town-hall-chase-supporters/), [Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1740993-thugs-attack-ndc-supporters-town-hall-meeting/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/video-thugs-invade-ndc-town-hall-meeting-in-lagos/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that armed hoodlums disrupted a town hall meeting organized by the Nigeria Democratic Congress in the Oregun area of Lagos State, attacking supporters.

reports.text: [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/microsoft-announces-the-full-restoration-of-its-service-after-the-technical-crash/) reported that technology company Microsoft announced the full restoration of its services following a technical crash.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/microsoft-s-widespread-outages-caused-global-chaos-including-in-the-healthcasre-industry) reported that Microsoft stated it is seeing improvements in service availability after an hours-long disruption affecting platforms including Outlook and Teams.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/massive-microsoft-outage-disrupts-businesses-schools-and-governments-around-the-world/) reported that a massive Microsoft outage disrupted businesses, schools, and governments globally by cutting access to Outlook and Teams.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-14/Microsoft-apologizes-for-global-outage-rules-out-cyberattack-1S3I9qOB6F2/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that Microsoft apologized for a global outage and ruled out a cyberattack.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/14/microsoft-apologises-for-global-outage-and-rules-out-cyberattack/) reported that Microsoft stated service has been restored across Teams, Outlook, and other products.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/microsoft-restablece-totalmente-su-servicio-tras-la-caida-tecnica-33130869) reported that Microsoft fully restored its service after a technical outage caused by an error during a previous network capacity expansion.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/microsoft-dice-que-restablecio-por-completo-el-servicio-tras-caida-a-nivel-mundial_0_r0vc83xCJ0.html) reported that the global outage left several products inoperative across 74 countries.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/microsoft-dice-que-restablecio-por-completo-el-servicio-tras-su-caida-a-nivel-mundial-y-alerta-por-estafas-que-buscan-aprovechar-el-caos-3601146) reported an alert regarding scams attempting to exploit the technical chaos.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/workday-outage-disrupts-11-500-businesses-worldwide-walmart-target-workers-face-payroll-and-hr-access-issues-101794666114407.html) reported that a Workday technical failure disrupted HR and payroll access for companies including Walmart and Target.

[HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/microsoft-outage_n_6af6ec51e4b065342906b58b) reported that Microsoft stated it is working to recover email and other services affected in the global outage.

[MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/13/microsoft-restores-services-after-a-global-outage-hit-outlook-and-teams-in-more-than-70-countries?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss) reported that Microsoft stated its services were recovering after a global outage that began on Thursday afternoon.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/microsoft-announces-service-restored-global-outage-over/) reported that Microsoft announced it has restored service to customers, drawing a close to a global outage.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/secteur/high-tech/outlook-teams-copilot-microsoft-annonce-la-fin-de-la-panne-mondiale-apres-plus-de-24-heures-de-perturbations-20261114) reported that the American giant announced the restoration of all its services following a global disruption.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/tech/microsoft-global-outage-down-nhs-b3084951.html) reported that Microsoft stated the disruption was due to a technical issue not related to cyber or AI agents.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/14/microsoft-says-services-fully-restored-after-global-outage) reported that operations were restored to all customers and regions affected by one of the worst IT failures in years.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/technology/microsoft-says-consumer-products-fully-recovered-3725563) reported that Microsoft announced its consumer products and services fully recovered following a global outage affecting users in at least 70 countries.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cqzjr903n01po?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that a server outage affected Microsoft services including Teams, Outlook, and Copilot.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/13/outlook-outage-hits-users-in-74-countries-as-microsoft-seeks-fix/) reported that an Outlook outage hit users in 74 countries while Microsoft sought alternative solutions.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/14/microsoft-outage-recovered/) reported that Microsoft stated server issues were behind the incident affecting consumer products services and ruled out AI as the cause.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/microsoft-says-consumer-products-services-recovered-still-monitoring-enterprise-services/article71701075.ece) reported that the technology giant stated it was monitoring the backlog of email messages accrued during the event before considering enterprise services.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/technology/20261114-microsoft-says-consumer-products-fully-recovered-business-services-improving) reported that Microsoft confirmed all services across Teams, Outlook, Copilot, and other applications fully recovered, ending the global outage.

[Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353954/global-outage-hits-microsoft-outlook), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/microsoft-struggles-as-outage-hits-outlook-teams-copilot-worldwide), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/microsoft-outage-hits-outlook-teams-worldwide-draws-130000-us-reports/) reported that a major global Microsoft outage knocked out Outlook, Teams, and the Copilot AI assistant for businesses and government agencies across multiple regions.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/microsoft-outage-services-across-all-previously-affected-environments-restored-microsoft-365-outage-teams-outlook-101794629719606.html) reported that Microsoft stated services across all previously affected environments have been restored.
[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10936977) reported that Microsoft issued an apology as a global outage affecting email and office software services stretched into a second day.

[HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/microsoft-outage_n_6af6ec51e4b065342906b58b), [Mail & Guardian](https://mg.co.za/news/tech/2026-11-13-microsoft-outage-disrupts-email-and-workplace-services-across-south-africa/), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581230/hours-long-microsoft-outage-disrupts-businesses-and-governments-globally/) reported that Microsoft stated it was seeing improvements for Outlook email and other Microsoft 365 services following a global outage that disrupted businesses and governments.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/14/microsoft-outage-stabilizing/) reported that Microsoft stated server issues were behind the incident and that a broader rollout of software fixes was stabilizing the system.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/14/microsoft-deeply-sorry-for-global-disruption-that-could-have-billion-dollar-impact-on-australia) reported that Microsoft said it was deeply sorry for the global disruption and that services were being restored.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/global-outage-microsoft-blames-network-change-for-service-disruption/) reported that Microsoft blamed a network change for a global outage that disrupted its workplace services including Outlook and Teams.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/microsoft-outlook-outage-status-microsoft-365-services-live-updates-november-14-2026/article71700692.ece) reported that Microsoft is testing fixes, rerouting traffic, and boosting server capacity.

[Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353954/global-outage-hits-microsoft-outlook) reported that Microsoft Outlook suffered a major global outage with tens of thousands of users struggling to access their email.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/microsoft-struggles-as-outage-hits-outlook-teams-copilot-worldwide) reported that the outage knocked out Outlook, Teams, and the Copilot AI assistant for businesses and government agencies worldwide.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/que-fallo-en-la-caida-de-microsoft-las-claves-en-las-24-horas-de-trabajos-de-recuperacion-33118843) reported that Microsoft attributed the global service outage to a failure during a prior capacity expansion and stated that services are generally recovering.

[Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353954/global-outage-hits-microsoft-outlook), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/microsoft-struggles-as-outage-hits-outlook-teams-copilot-worldwide) reported that Microsoft Outlook, Teams, and Copilot experienced a major global outage affecting users worldwide.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/cqx2e0pl80gro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/world/outage-in-microsoft-services-affects-tens-of-thousands-of-users-9yx9g5w) reported that tens of thousands of users suffered disruptions to Microsoft's online services.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/microsoft-outage-improvements-for-outlook-and-other-services-around-globe/PZYAOUDJKVAIRBOIGXZLIOYQMA/) reported that Microsoft achieved a broad recovery for Outlook and other global services, while visa processing, property settlements, and courts experienced disruptions.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/microsoft-atribuye-caida-global-de-sus-servicios-a-un-fallo-tecnico-anuncia-una-recuperacion-generalizada/) reported that Microsoft attributed the global service outage to a technical flaw and announced a general recovery while ruling out cybersecurity issues.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/caida-microsoft-expone-riesgo-fallos-cascada-integracion-servicios_1794596886) reported that the service interruption began at midday on Thursday and lasted more than 20 hours.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/england-health-service-triggers-contingency-microsoft-outage.1137044) reported that England's health service triggered contingency plans due to the Microsoft outage affecting Outlook and Teams.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/microsoft-says-day-long-outage-triggered-by-technical-issue-rules-out-role-of-ai-cyber-agents-101794589974056.html) reported that Microsoft stated a technical issue caused the day-long outage and ruled out the role of AI and cyber agents.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/secteur/high-tech/panne-chez-microsoft-le-recit-de-24-heures-de-pagaille-dans-les-entreprises-les-hopitaux-et-les-gouvernements-du-monde-entier-20261113) reported that millions of users in enterprises, hospitals, and governments were affected by the 24-hour Microsoft outage.

reports.text: [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218511), a state-media outlet, reported that Chinese Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Mao Ning stated the upcoming gathering will be the first-ever face-to-face meeting between the leaders of China, Russia, and the US.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/washington-moscow-confirm-historic-trump-xi-and-putin-meeting/news) reported that Washington and Moscow confirmed plans for U.S. President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Chinese President Xi Jinping to meet on Thursday.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/russia-downs-over-100-drones-targeting-moscow-ahead-of-putin-s-meeting-with-trump-xi-101794801168344.html) reported that Moscow Mayor Sergey Sobyanin stated Russian air defenses intercepted about 139 drones targeting Moscow.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/sheinbaum-llega-a-china-para-su-primera-cumbre-de-la-apec-sostendra-reunion-con-xi-jinping-33154883) reported that Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum arrived in China for her first APEC summit and a scheduled meeting with Xi Jinping.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/china-confirma-reunion-entre-xi-trump-y-putin-este-jueves-en-shenzhen-33153944) reported that China confirmed the APEC summit will be held on November 18 and 19 in Shenzhen, hosting leaders from 21 economies.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/china-confirma-cupula-trilateral-de-xi-com-trump-e-putin-na-quinta-19.shtml) reported that Beijing confirmed on Sunday night that Chinese leader Xi Jinping will meet with Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/china-confirma-cumbre-trilateral-de-xi-jinping-con-trump-y-putin-el-19-de-noviembre_0_s7fxaBusp3.html) reported that China confirmed that the leaders of China, Russia, and the United States will hold a trilateral summit in Shenzhen on November 19 during the APEC summit.

[MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/16/trump-putin-and-xi-to-hold-their-first-three-way-meeting-in-china-on-thursday?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss), [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218433) reported that Chinese, US, and Russian officials confirmed that US President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Chinese President Xi Jinping will hold their first three-way meeting in Shenzhen on Thursday, November 19, on the sidelines of the APEC summit.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/mondo/2026/11/15/il-principe-harry-in-ucraina-incontra-i-soldati-feriti-vincerete-la-guerra_55fd8bb0-9a72-41d8-8a0a-f931476fbc75.html), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/el-principe-harry-visito-por-sorpresa-lviv-y-les-dijo-a-los-soldados-ucranianos-que-van-a-ganar-la-nid15112026/) reported that Britain's Prince Harry paid a surprise visit to Lviv, Ukraine, where he attended a conference on war trauma and told wounded soldiers they will win the war.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/la-nueva-yalta-reunion-entre-trump-xi-y-putin-en-la-apec-europa-expresa-preocupacion/) reported that experts recalled the conference that ended World War II in discussing a meeting between Trump, Xi, and Putin at APEC.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/sheinbaum-viaja-a-china-por-cumbre-apec-reunion-con-xi-jinping-y-dialogo-con-empresarios-en-la-agenda/) reported that Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum traveled to China for the APEC summit.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/ucrania-la-guerra-de-putin-que-trump-ha-perpetuado/) reported that Washington's assistance to Kyiv was practically suspended under Donald Trump, while the domestic development of Ukrainian military capabilities was incentivized.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/ucrania-burla-putin-cumbre-yalta-1945-pero-eso-debe-ganar-guerra-mundial_202611156af9af064196933d7ede1f29.html) reported that Ukraine's foreign minister stated Russia has suffered 1.6 million casualties since the beginning of the war.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/kremlin-confirma-reunion-de-trump-xi-y-putin-en-la-apec-se-ha-llegado-a-un-acuerdo-dice/) reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov confirmed the trilateral meeting between Trump, Xi, and Putin will take place on November 19 during APEC.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/una-cumbre-sin-precedentes-moscu-confirma-reunion-entre-trump-putin-y-xi-jinping-33140791) reported that according to Washington, no discussion on the conflict in Ukraine is planned for the meeting.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/un-nuevo-yalta-la-inedita-cumbre-tripartita-entre-putin-xi-y-trump-que-inquieta-a-europa-y-ucrania-nid15112026/) reported that the leaders of the United States, Russia, and China will meet in Shenzhen in a trilateral summit.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/donald-trump-vladimir-putin-y-xi-jinping-se-sentaran-a-la-misma-mesa-en-una-historica-cumbre-trilateral-el-19-de-noviembre-3601115) reported that Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin, and Xi Jinping will hold a trilateral summit in Shenzhen on November 19 to address nuclear arms reduction.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218203), a Russian state outlet, reported that the trilateral summit will take place on November 19 on the sidelines of the APEC summit.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/putin-xi-trump-apec-summit/) reported that the summit in Shenzhen will address nuclear arms control, U.S.-Iran tensions, and global strategic stability.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20261114-china-to-host-first-ever-trilateral-meeting-between-trump-xi-and-putin-next-week-us-says) reported that the three leaders are scheduled to meet on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen on Thursday.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4184573-trump-to-meet-with-xi-and-putin-next-thursday-new-york-post.html) reported that US President Donald Trump will hold a trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian leader Vladimir Putin on November 19 in Shenzhen, China.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062814/) reported that the U.S., Russian, and Chinese leaders are set to meet at the APEC summit in Shenzhen to discuss a nuclear arms control agreement and Iran.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/mort-de-vladimir-poutine-en-2027-paix-en-ukraine-guerre-en-estonie-l-improbable-scenario-du-futur-brandi-par-le-think-tank-americain-rand-20261113) reported that a think tank, RAND, published a scenario including the death of Vladimir Putin in 2027, peace in Ukraine, and war in Estonia.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/14/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-des-discussions-sur-l-ukraine-ne-sont-pas-prevues-lors-de-la-rencontre-trilaterale-entre-trump-poutine-et-xi-annoncee-par-la-maison-blanche_6808609_3210.html) reported that Washington clarified that discussions at the APEC summit meeting would focus on nuclear disarmament rather than Ukraine.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/trump-xi-e-putin-vao-se-reunir-na-china-na-proxima-quinta-19-diz-casa-branca.shtml) reported that the White House announced US President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Chinese leader Xi Jinping will meet in China.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxPX1dzUndCOE42aUFUazd4SFcxMFVWUTl6VmRVOE5QR0ZjNWRXY19qWTVuRUthUXhDS3UybmZnQmFHSHVRV20wdXJwTUlKUTlGVU42N1B4bkVwSjI4bkdJeG94aFpxX01NUTdyWUJOUVZHSHlXZkxGZXlsTWhjSmUwRXoyRklMekIycXlEUk1pM1NpNjJp?oc=5), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/north-america/trump-to-have-first-trilateral-meeting-with-putin-xi-20261114-p61e4y.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/donald-trump-to-raise-nuclear-arms-cuts-with-putin-xi-on-november-19-white-house-says/article71700773.ece) reported that White House officials stated Donald Trump plans to discuss nuclear-arms cuts with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/historic-first-summit-among-trump-xi-putin-will-not-focus-on-ukraine-white-house-says/) reported that a U.S. official stated the trilateral meeting will focus on nuclear non-proliferation and the war in Iran.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648828-trump-putin-xi-meeting-/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a state outlet, reported that the leaders of Russia, China, and the US plan to meet in Shenzhen with nuclear arms control and global conflicts on the agenda.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/trump-to-hold-first-ever-joint-meeting-with-xi-and-putin-on-the-sidelines-of-apec-in-china-101794614552520.html), [CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/east-asia/trump-xi-putin-trilateral-summit-apec-6551001) reported that White House officials stated Trump plans to discuss nuclear arms reductions and the war in Iran.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/trump-hold-summit-xi-putin-shenzhen-thursday-ny-post-reports) reported that US President Donald Trump will hold a trilateral summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen on Thursday.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2217395), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/12/8062593/), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/89960) reported that Russian presidential aides and officials stated Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump plan to discuss Ukraine during a meeting at the APEC summit in China.
