reports.text: [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/metro/1009682/pnp-defends-police-mobile-parked-at-manila-motel-amid-asean-summit/story/) reported that the Philippine National Police defended the presence of a police mobile allegedly parked at a motel in Manila amid ASEAN Summit security operations.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/muntinlupa-city-protest-arrest-asean-2026/) reported that nearly 300 protesters belonging to Lakbayan Timog Katagalugan were arrested in Muntinlupa as the ASEAN Summit opened.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/metro/1009639/groups-slam-arrests-dispersal-of-asean-summit-protesters/story/) reported that several organizations condemned the arrest and alleged violent dispersal of protesters in Metro Manila during the opening of the 49th ASEAN Summit.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/442823/prabowo-urges-stronger-asean-unity-ahead-of-60th-anniversary) reported that Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto called on ASEAN members to strengthen unity ahead of the bloc's 60th anniversary.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/metro/1009634/over-200-protesters-arrested-in-para-aque-amid-asean-summit-2026-opening/story/) reported that over 200 protesters from Southern Tagalog were arrested in Parañaque during the opening of the ASEAN Summit 2026.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/asean-leaders-discuss-myanmar-seek-practical-way-forward-in-manila-3725598) reported that Philippines President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. told his ASEAN counterparts in Manila that Myanmar remains an integral part of the bloc during discussions on finding a practical way forward.

[Global New Light of Myanmar](https://www.gnlm.com.mm/myanmar-delegation-attends-28th-asean-economic-community-council-meeting-in-manila/), a state-media outlet, reported that a Myanmar delegation led by Union Minister U Aung Kyaw Hoe attended the 28th ASEAN Economic Community Council Meeting in Manila.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/metro/1009547/protesters-assure-peaceful-march-to-picc-as-asean-summit-starts/story/) reported that several protest actions were held as the ASEAN Summit 2026 kicked off at the Philippine International Convention Center.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/metro/1009583/9-arrested-as-police-disperse-asean-summit-protesters-kmu-act/story/) reported that police arrested nine individuals as officers dispersed protesters marching toward the Cultural Center of the Philippines Complex.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/asean-summit-manila-2026/) reported that the 2026 ASEAN Summit in Manila opened with 11 member leaders discussing integration, cooperation, and the energy crisis following the Hormuz closure.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/442743/indonesia-reaffirms-commitment-to-reinforcing-asean-unity-centrality) reported that Indonesian Foreign Minister Arrmanatha Nasir reaffirmed Indonesia's commitment to reinforcing ASEAN unity and centrality.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/442799/prabowo-calls-for-stronger-asean-unity-and-centrality) reported that Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto called for stronger collective action and ASEAN unity.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/metro/1009588/look-un-chief-slovak-foreign-minister-visit-manila-cathedral/story/) reported that UN Secretary-General António Guterres and Slovak Foreign Minister Juraj Blanár visited the Manila Cathedral.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxPM3dOT2Y2RVpRSFdZX1EzTmVkNkpPYVVNdTFRZ3VSb2JDRDRnMEJvNlVzUjV5QXh1TndkQnRtODdrZXhtd3ZmNXJqeUNXVHdHZzFUOGlZcWhmeXdBaXRNRUFRRTlfOGRZclRDSUw1SndkRFptdmkxTFd6dk9JQW54UUhmN01LVDN0QVhGcDZ0eXZQUG0zVktrV2E4eVV0bGhsTmpNYU5R?oc=5) reported that Southeast Asian leaders opened their annual summit with major conflicts and their impact topping the agenda.
[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/pax-silica-protest-arrest-asean-opening-manila/) reported that police arrested at least 11 protesters as the ASEAN Summit opened in Manila.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/15/protesters-condemn-us-policies-as-asean-summit-begins-in-manila?traffic_source=rss) reported that Southeast Asian leaders arriving in Manila for the ASEAN summit were met with protests condemning U.S. policies.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581832/global-powers-gather-in-manila-as-asean-summit-begins/) reported that global powers gathered in Manila for the opening of the ASEAN summit to address regional and global challenges.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/lawrence-wong-asean-summit-manila-6552066) reported that Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong spoke at the plenary session of the 49th ASEAN Summit in Manila, stating that ASEAN should focus on the digital economy, energy resilience, and broadening networks amidst global uncertainty.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/442791/prabowo-urges-stronger-asean-resilience-amid-global-turmoil), a state-run outlet, reported that Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto urged ASEAN member states to bolster regional resilience and unity.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/442767/prabowo-attends-retreat-session-of-49th-asean-summit-in-metro-manila) reported that President Prabowo Subianto attended the Retreat Session of the 49th ASEAN Summit in the Philippines on Sunday.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/canada-mark-carney-manila-cathedral-visit/) reported that Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney visited Manila Cathedral and Fort Santiago after meeting with Philippine President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/metro/1009577/look-canada-brazil-leaders-visit-manila-cathedral-on-sidelines-of-asean-summit/story/) reported that Canadian Prime Minister Mark Joseph Carney and Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva visited the Manila Cathedral.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/15/asia-pacific/politics/asean-manila-summit/) reported that Southeast Asian heads of state faced questions on trade, security, and an ongoing energy crisis at the ASEAN summit in Manila.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/metro/1009564/5-people-arrested-2-hurt-in-manila-amid-asean-summit-protests/story/) reported that five people were arrested and two hurt in Manila as protesters attempted to march towards Pasay City during the ASEAN Summit.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/442751/prabowo-receives-personal-welcome-from-marcos-at-49th-asean-summit) reported that Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto received a personal welcome from Philippine President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. at the 49th ASEAN Summit.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1009524/indonesia-thailand-malaysia-leaders-arrive-for-49th-asean-summit/story/) reported that Indonesian, Thai, and Malaysian leaders arrived in the Philippines for the 49th ASEAN Summit.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/expectations-49th-asean-summit-november-2026/) reported that the South China Sea Code of Conduct, Myanmar's political standing in ASEAN, and the Middle East crisis' impact on oil and food security will top the agenda as the 49th ASEAN Summit begins in Manila.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxQSnl6T2hQSElYUzA0RXNscy1hcS1aQi1mX3ZvN3FaZnhPNnlyaG05QkRlU3BZdGdUR2Z1ZXJuVnVxRzdTRnpRSzR1NnBDTGs0a0EyVE5YLTFiVWFNcHAwelBmWVh1SE5STFYybDVzY3JiejQtNmM2R2Z1TkY2MzR2MFNGclQ1cmFsY0FtM2l6MEhiSnVS?oc=5) reported that Southeast Asian leaders will call for peaceful resolutions of conflicts and Donald Trump will join final talks.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/442723/president-prabowo-arrives-in-manila-for-49th-asean-summit), an Indonesian state media outlet, reported that Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto arrived in Manila to attend the 49th ASEAN Summit.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1009513/palace-urges-students-to-submit-position-paper-on-pax-silica/story/) reported that Malacañang urged students to submit position papers regarding the proposed Pax Silica Economic Security Zone.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1009520/rubio-to-accompany-trump-during-philippines-visit-for-asean-summit/story/) reported that US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is expected to accompany President Donald Trump during his visit to the Philippines for the ASEAN Summit.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/1009472/watch-protests-staged-vs-trump-s-arrival-in-ph-for-asean-summit-2026/story/) reported that several groups staged protest actions ahead of the arrival of US President Donald Trump in the Philippines for the ASEAN Summit.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/pm-wong-asean-summit-chairmanship-manila-6547156) reported that Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong will visit Manila for the ASEAN Summit and related meetings.

reports.text: [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/adebutu-ogun-apc-guber-aspirant-hails-court-judgment/) reported that Ogun State All Progressives Congress governorship aspirant Abayomi Hunye congratulated the Peoples Democratic Party's governorship candidate following a court judgment.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/gov-oyebanji-rallies-apc-candidates-promises-campaign-support-assures-members-of-political-inclusion/) reported that Ekiti State Governor Biodun Oyebanji reaffirmed his commitment to strengthening the APC and promised full logistical support for upcoming elections.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/adebutu-hunye-hails-court-judgment-says-its-victory-for-democracy/) reported that Hunye described a court judgment regarding Adebutu as a victory for democracy and justice for Ogun State.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/pdp-celebrates-as-adebutu-floors-inec/) reported that a court ordered the Independent National Electoral Commission to publish Oladipupo Adebutu as the Peoples Democratic Party governorship candidate.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-katsina-pdp-gov-candidate-promises-free-medical-treatment-for-residents/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that PDP governorship candidate in Katsina, Yakubu Lado Danmarke, promised to introduce free healthcare services for residents if elected in 2027.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611130470.html) reported that following a boost to Ladi Adebutu's candidacy, the Peoples Democratic Party vowed to reclaim Ogun State in the 2027 gubernatorial election.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/ogun-2027-court-orders-inec-to-publish-adebutu-as-pdp-candidate-says-commission-lacks-powers-to-disqualify-him/) reported that Justice Peter Lifu of the Federal High Court ordered INEC to publish Adebutu as the PDP candidate.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ogun-guber-pdp-celebrates-court-judgment-reinstating-adebutu/), [The Authority (Nigeria)](https://authorityngr.com/2026/11/13/pdp-seeks-inec-compliance-as-court-reinstates-adebutu-as-ogun-governorship-candidate/), [Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/925024-2027-pdp-reacts-to-court-ruling-reinstating-adebutu-as-ogun-gov-candidate-urges-inec-to-comply.html) reported that the Peoples Democratic Party welcomed the Federal High Court judgment reinstating Adebutu as its Ogun governorship candidate and urged INEC to comply.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/inec-chairman-amupitan-denies-operating-pro-tinubu-x-account/) reported that INEC Chairman Prof. Joash Amupitan denied operating an X account allegedly used to express support for Tinubu.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/inec-to-obey-court-on-atikus-adc-candidacy-amupitan/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-inec-will-obey-court-ruling-on-atikus-candidacy-amupitan/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that INEC Chairman Prof. Joash Amupitan stated the commission will abide by the final court decision on Atiku Abubakar's presidential candidacy under the ADC.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741071-will-atiku-participate-2027-election-inec-chairman-speaks-out/) reported that Amupitan explained what happens to Atiku's 2027 bid if he loses his court battle.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/ogun-2027-court-orders-inec-to-publish-adebutus-name-says-commission-lacks-powers-to-unilaterally-remove-candidates/) The Sun reported that the Federal High Court ruled that INEC has no power to unilaterally disqualify a candidate and ordered it to publish Adebutu's name.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ogun-2027-pdp-celebrates-adebutu-ruling-vows-to-reclaim-state/) reported that the PDP in Ogun State celebrated the Adebutu ruling and vowed to reclaim the state.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/driver-absconds-with-employers-n45m-suv-caught-within-hours-in-ogun/) reported that a driver who allegedly absconded with his employer's Lexus 460 SUV in Ogun was caught within hours.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/court-orders-inec-to-reinstate-adebutu-as-ogun-pdp-guber-candidate-within-24-hours/) reported that the Federal High Court in Abuja ordered INEC to publish Oladipupo Adebutu's name as the PDP governorship candidate within 24 hours.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/13/ogun-2027-court-orders-inec-to-publish-adebutus-name/) reported that the Federal High Court ruled that INEC had no power to unilaterally disqualify a candidate from contesting.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/13/money-cant-buy-peoples-conscience-says-sowunmi-kolapo/) reported that Ogun State PDP deputy governorship candidate Yemi Sowunmi-Kolapo stated money cannot buy people's conscience.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/adebutu-knows-fate-today-as-court-gives-judgment-on-his-exclusion-from-inec-list/) reported that the Federal High Court fixed Friday to deliver judgment in the suit filed by the PDP.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/13/imo-east-senatorial-candidacy-court-orders-ndc-to-submit-uche-nwoles-name-to-inec/) reported that Justice Mohammed Umar of the Federal High Court in Abuja ordered the Nigeria Democratic Congress to submit Uche Nwole's name to INEC for the Imo East senatorial candidacy.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/2027-money-cant-buy-ogun-voters-says-pdp-deputy-gov-candidate/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that PDP deputy governorship candidate Yemi Sowunmi-Kolapo stated money politics will not suppress voter will in the 2027 election.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/just-in-court-orders-inec-to-publish-adebutus-name-as-ogun-pdp-gov-candidate/), [Punch](https://punchng.com/breaking-court-orders-inec-to-reinstate-adebutu-as-ogun-pdp-gov-candidate/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that a Federal High Court in Abuja ordered INEC to reinstate Ladi Adebutu as the PDP governorship candidate for Ogun State within 24 hours.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/13/tanker-collides-with-new-orleans-river-cruise-carrying-129-passengers-rescue-operation-und), [CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxPd0V2MmU4SUFIMmtTR091bTZlaG96X29GdVRIVjc4c1JaMWdYVldWa09rVFVnNjI3aWszdnh5Vlhadm1relhMSV9sT2xHVkZ4c2lQMjZ6bnZvX3BCbmJ4LVdNY3c5aXhlcnNyZFc0QjNZS2V3anZfSDZsVmdJdnNUazdlbHlIUXBZLU5FQWNZM2hnS2oyeEVWag?oc=5), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/ck4gn4y77m40o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/tanker-collides-with-cruise-ship-on-mississippi-near-new-orleans/a-79945080?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/13/us/new-orleans-cruise-ship-crash.html), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/13/mississippi-river-crash-new-orleans), [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/new-orleans-river-boat-crash-129-passengers-b3084807.html), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/mississippi-river-crash-american-cruise-line-boat-and-oil-tanker-collision-near-new-orleans-port-leave-several-in-the-water-101794600922214.html), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/united-states-canada/article/3374410/tanker-hits-new-orleans-cruise-boat-carrying-129-passengers), [Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/cruise-ship-hit-by-tanker-in-new-orleans-passengers-in-water-20261114-p61e41.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that a tanker collided with a river cruise boat carrying around 129 passengers near New Orleans, prompting a rescue operation.

reports.text: [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581941/us-air-travel-expected-to-return-to-normal-by-monday-after-three-days-of-disruptions/) reported that United States air travel disruptions affected more than 11,500 flights nationwide over three days.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-16/US-transportation-secretary-refuses-to-apologize-for-FAA-ground-stop-1S6PigDFnPy/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy refused to apologize for the Federal Aviation Administration's nationwide ground stop.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/sean-duffy-made-the-call-to-shut-down-flights-now-he-s-making-his-case-101794797904845.html) reported that Sean Duffy is pressing Congress for billions in funds following his decision to ground thousands of flights.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-16/trump-breaks-silence-after-airline-ground-stop/107388942) reported that US President Donald Trump blamed the Biden administration for an airline ground stop and insisted Congress approve funds to upgrade air traffic control systems.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/faa-issues-brief-ground-stop-at-orlando-international-airport-after-aircraft-experiences-blown-tire-101794787396896.html) reported that the FAA issued a brief ground stop at Orlando International Airport after a Southwest Airlines flight experienced a blown tire.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/15/us/faa-groundstop-flights-status-delays-canceled.html) reported that operations are returning to normal after air traffic was shut down for more than four hours following a maintenance upgrade.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/more-than-900-us-flights-cancelled-sunday-after-fridays-ground-stop/) reported that FlightAware recorded 910 cancellations for Sunday after more than 6,400 flights were cancelled on Saturday.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/congress-federal-aviation-administration-trump-joe-biden-united-states-b3085291.html), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/united-states-canada/article/3374509/trump-breaks-silence-us-ground-stop-demands-more-money-congress), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/trump-breaks-silence-on-us-ground-stop-urges-congress-to-fund-air-traffic-control-overhaul-101794762495147.html) reported that President Donald Trump broke his silence on the nationwide ground stop and urged Congress to fund an air traffic control overhaul.

[The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/15/trump-slams-bidens-management-faa-mass-flight-cancellations-delays/) reported that President Trump blamed the Biden administration's handling of the FAA for Friday's nationwide ground stop.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/11/14/us/faa-nationwide-ground-stop-flights/democrats-congress-faa) reported that Democrats pushed back on the demand for $50 billion to upgrade air traffic systems.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-flight-cancellations-expose-old-air-traffic-control-system-as-faa-seeks-50-billion-for-upgrades-101794745900687.html) reported that US flight cancellations exposed outdated technology as the FAA faces calls for $50 billion.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cw1mdlv0k2r4o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that thousands of US flights are still cancelled or delayed two days after the grounding of planes nationwide, and normal operations may not be restored until Monday.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-14/news-1S3CjcBaTg4/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World), a state-media outlet, reported that the FAA lifted the nationwide ground stop after thousands of flights were disrupted.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/us-probes-nationwide-flights-stoppage-as-travel-disruptions-persist) reported that US air travel is expected to return to normal following a nationwide ground stop.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/us/2026/1115/1599251-us-flight-chaos-continues-after-nationwide-faa-shutdown/) reported that the head of the FAA stated US air travel is not expected to return to normal schedules until later today as the aviation system recovers from a nationwide shutdown.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/dallas-love-field-airport-reopens-after-brief-closure-over-faa-issued-alert-concerning-security-issue-101794727974287.html) reported that Dallas Love Field airport briefly suspended operations following a security alert involving a commercial aircraft.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/hot-mess-for-americans-mississippi-senator-elect-scott-colom-stranded-at-atlanta-airport-amid-delta-pilot-shortage-and-faa-ground-stop-101794730136703.html) reported that Mississippi Senator-elect Scott Colom was stranded at Atlanta Airport amid a Delta pilot shortage and FAA ground stop.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxPVUkzUkUtOXFKRWc1dS14cHgwQzhLclZFZjNzZFJkb3R2X0JDSlJaYnR5bE1QbHhtZjhtWDZVN3VaNkNISUtqdkFtUktDMHJ3RHdEajZFLUF4RFdfTm5MaXZzRjJFRXR6UTBYcXVndGtwOGlVbHlLYXd5eFc0THc2d0ZWSUhSaGVjekE?oc=5) reported that the FAA ground stop disrupted travel for the NBA, NHL, and college football.
[Jamaica Observer](https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/11/14/faa-says-16000-flights-canceled-us-air-disruption/) reported that the FAA stated more than 16,000 flights were canceled.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/us-air-travel-may-take-until-sunday-night-to-return-to-normal/) reported that US air travel may not return to normal until Sunday night following a nationwide disruption caused by technical problems.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-air-travel-not-expected-to-return-to-normal-schedules-until-late-on-sunday-faa-head-101794711940462.html) reported that Federal Aviation Administration head Bryan Bedford expected airline operations to largely return to normal by late Sunday.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/dallas-love-field-airport-closed-due-to-potential-bomb-threat-day-after-faa-grounded-flights-across-country-101794714394776.html) reported that Dallas Love Field Airport closed due to a potential bomb threat a day after the FAA grounded flights.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/14/passengers-continue-to-face-delays-and-cancellations-after-us-lifts-nationwide-ground-stop) reported that US Transport Secretary Sean Duffy blamed the stoppage on an incredibly old air traffic control system.

[The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/13/faa-expanded-ai-air-traffic-tool-centers-days-nationwide-ground-stop/) reported that Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said SMART is not connected to the agency's core radar and flight-tracking systems.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640263/trump-official-seeks-50-billion-for-air-traffic-control-after-outage) reported that Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy and the White House asked for $30.1 billion to upgrade aging airports and the air traffic control system.

[TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2218089), a Russian state outlet, reported that Secretary of Transportation Sean Duffy noted the administration has been asking Congress for the last year to fully fund a build of a brand new system.

[El País](https://elpais.com/us/2026-11-14/washington-atribuye-el-paron-aereo-a-un-problema-con-un-nuevo-cableado-de-fibra-optica.html) reported that Washington attributed the flight halt to a problem with new fiber-optic cabling and ruled out a cyberattack.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/eua-impoem-suspensao-nacional-de-voos-por-razoes-de-seguranca.shtml) reported that the US Federal Aviation Administration suspended all departures nationwide.

[O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/mundo-e-ciencia/2026/11/7322476-falha-em-cabo-de-comunicacao-causou-caos-aereo-nos-eua.html) reported that the US Transportation Secretary stated a communication cable failure caused the disruption and ruled out hacker attacks or AI interference.

[The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/14/sean-duffy-blames-tech-contractor-faa-outage/) reported that Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said an L3Harris contractor is responsible for the outage.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/us/2026/11/14/us-air-travel-slowly-recovers-after-longest-nationwide-shutdown-since-2001/) reported that the transport secretary stated a contractor's installation of at least one new router at a remote facility triggered the disruption.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/falla-en-sistema-aereo-de-eu-fue-por-cambio-de-cables-de-cobre-a-fibra-optica-dice-el-secretario-de-transporte-33132344), [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/14/eua-descartam-ataques-hackers-sobre-caos-aereo-e-indicam-problema-com-a-troca-de-cabos-substituimos-quase-70percent-para-fibra.ghtml) reported that US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy stated the FAA system failure occurred when a contractor was replacing old copper cabling with fiber optics.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/14/us/politics/ground-stop-air-traffic-faa.html) reported that the Federal Aviation Administration's aging infrastructure has experienced several disruptive failures in recent months.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/14/us-blames-system-upgrade-for-longest-nationwide-faa-ground-stop-since-9?traffic_source=rss) reported that Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy stated his agency is going to hold people accountable.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/transportation-secretary-sean-duffy-explains-what-caused-faa-nationwide-ground-stop-contractor-error-or-faulty-equipment-101794675054311.html) reported that Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy stated a contractor's work on a router may have caused the FAA outage and ruled out a cyberattack.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/us/2026/1114/1599194-travel-stop-lifted/) reported that the ground stop of flights in the US has been lifted following a communications failure at air traffic control centres.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/rio/noticia/2026/11/14/cancelamentos-apos-pane-nos-eua-afetam-voos-no-galeao.ghtml), [O Dia](https://odia.ig.com.br/rio-de-janeiro/2026/11/7322389-galeao-tem-cancelamentos-apos-suspensao-de-voos-nos-eua.html) reported that flights between Brazil and the United States faced cancellations and alterations following the flight suspension in the US.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxOaF96ME41YXAwZ1N4NUJ3dDMwVkRlQi1QSzhhRWFBWk9iYWpNQ1daSzZlcGFOSnBoejRfZnZhSHJzMXdjQU95ZnNmYUMtQXdaWEwwQTdFT2M3UU9pbGdhR3BmeHVfTHRfX2RYWU5lLS1hUF9LSFRzdW5ETlpxQS0yazJWbWh5M3lOYk1iTWJxaTFrYmJ5NG5rZXpn?oc=5), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-nationwide-flight-ground-stop-ends-but-delays-could-last-for-days-heres-what-passengers-need-to-know-101794662918716.html) reported that the nationwide ground stop for flights in the US ended, though delays are expected to continue.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxPVUkzUkUtOXFKRWc1dS14cHgwQzhLclZFZjNzZFJkb3R2X0JDSlJaYnR5bE1QbHhtZjhtWDZVN3VaNkNISUtqdkFtUktDMHJ3RHdEajZFLUF4RFdfTm5MaXZzRjJFRXR6UTBYcXVndGtwOGlVbHlLYXd5eFc0THc2d0ZWSUhSaGVjekE?oc=5) reported that the FAA grounded flights nationwide, disrupting sports travel for the weekend.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/faa-flights-resume-after-longest-us-travel-chaos-since-9-11-attacks/) reported that Transport Secretary Duffy attributed the disruption to the longest nationwide ground stop since the September 11, 2001, attacks.

reports.text: [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/hungarian-investigators-found-19-5-million-in-cash-buried-in-forests-and-hidden-in-buildings-while-probing-allegations-against-a-former-minister-treasury-staff-needed-eight-hours-and-five-machines-to-count-it/articleshow/135847472.cms) reported that Hungarian investigators found $19.5 million in cash buried in forests and hidden in buildings while probing allegations against a former minister.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/86180999), a Moldovan news outlet, reported that Hungarian authorities recovered cash worth nearly €17.7 million in an investigation involving former National Development Minister Miklós Seszták.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/europe/hungary-finds-30-million-cash-some-buried-in-forests-in-bribery-probe-20261115-p61e7e.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Hungary found $30 million in cash, some buried in forests, in a bribery probe.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/cash-found-in-hungary-in-anti-graft-probe-20261115-p61e8r.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported on footage released from Hungary’s National Asset Recovery and Protection Office showing cash found in an anti-graft probe.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/hungary-seizes-195-million-cash-hidden-forests-graft-probe.1137115) reported that Miklos Sesztak, two other ministers from Viktor Orban's cabinet, and his brother have been taken into custody in different cases.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/14/hungary-seizes-millions-in-cash-found-buried-in-forests-amid-corruption-investigation) reported that investigators uncovered large amounts of cash buried in forests, concealed in agricultural buildings, and stashed inside safes.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90112) reported that Hungary's National Asset Recovery and Protection Agency seized over 5 billion forints, €2.7 million, and $1.3 million in physical cash.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/14/hungarian-investigators-uncover-19-5m-hidden-in-forests-and-buildings?traffic_source=rss) reported that nearly $20 million was found in Hungary's forests and buildings amid a corruption probe into an ex-minister.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914852) reported that it took a dozen State Treasury workers eight hours to count the cash as part of Prime Minister Peter Magyar’s Operation Purgatory anti-corruption drive.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/13/hungary-seizes-195m-in-cash-found-buried-in-forests-amid-graft-inquiry), [Budapest Times](https://www.budapesttimes.hu/hungary/billions-in-buried-cash-found-in-forests-and-safes-in-ex-ministers-bribery-case/) reported that Hungary's anti-corruption agency seized $19.5 million in cash found buried in forests and safes as part of a bribery inquiry into an Orbán-era minister.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/saudi-led-coalition-intercepts-missiles-towards-riyadh-drones-eastern-province) reported that the Saudi-led coalition fighting Yemen's Houthi movement intercepted two ballistic missiles launched toward Riyadh and drones in the Eastern Province.

reports.text: [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/16/world/estonia-russia-border-sabotage-bid/) reported that Estonia's decision to close its border with Russia marked an escalation in regional tensions linked to Moscow's war against Ukraine.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxOVkhQYlBYSGp1OG16aUlIS0JBcWpXQnpYbDlDaVFqb0V4cG04dm9wbnptbW1WRnI1bmh2ck0tTmM2Vl9pYVN2dG5NVmpTM2liUG9JWDNkVTZPVUxQc0swQ3FuN3UyZ2tyanRHVENpeUQtbTl0Z3RYSlIzVFB3QnFtdzVvWURCWDlCVjhlclpUTlpWaVhxektwaEFtY2Z2ZGRUYmJ1Z0ozUW9jY0lSOURycDkxSktlRnc?oc=5), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/15/estonia-to-close-border-crossings-with-russia-after-alleged-arson-attack?traffic_source=rss), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/estonia-to-close-border-with-russia-after-moscow-linked-sabotage-attempt-on-drone-maker/) reported that Estonia is closing its border crossings with Russia following an alleged or attempted arson attack on a drone manufacturer.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218399), a Russian state outlet, reported that Russian diplomat Maria Zakharova stated Moscow will check information about Estonia's plans and view it as Russophobia if confirmed.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/15/estonian-drone-maker-targeted-by-gru-ordered-sabotage-attempt-pm-says) reported that Prime Minister Kristen Michal said Estonia was preparing to potentially close its border with Russia.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90184) reported that Estonian security authorities thwarted an attempted explosion and arson attack against drone manufacturer Threod Systems and detained suspects.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218363), a Russian state-owned outlet, reported that Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna announced Estonia will close all Estonian-Russian border crossing points as of December 1.

reports.text: [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/poco-a-poco-hay-que-darle-tiempo-cuando-felix-gallardo-pidio-confiar-en-amlo-para-combatir-la-violencia-en-mexico/) reported that drug lord Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo died at the age of 80 after spending 37 years in prison.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/el-sacrificio-de-kiki-nunca-sera-olvidado-terry-cole-jefe-de-la-dea-reacciona-a-muerte-de-felix-gallardo/) reported that DEA chief Terry Cole reacted to the death of Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo, stating that Kiki Camarena's sacrifice will never be forgotten.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/15/world/americas/felix-gallardo-mexico-dead.html) reported that Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo, who helped build the foundations of modern-day drug empires, died in prison.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/mexico-notorious-drug-lord-felix-gallardo-dies/) reported that Mexican drug lord Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo died at the age of 80 in a hospital due to multiple organ failure.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/felix-gallardo-el-capo-que-convirtio-el-narcotrafico-en-un-negocio-de-alianzas-y-proteccion-politica-33152246) reported that Guadalajara Cartel founder Felix Gallardo understood that criminal power depended on articulating producers, transporters, financiers, and political protection.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/felix-gallardo-el-capo-que-hacia-valer-su-jerarquia-en-el-altiplano-33152474) reported that Israel Vallarta's book portrays Felix Gallardo in prison as a reclusive, nearly blind man in deteriorating health.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261115-miguel-angel-felix-gallardo-mexican-drug-lord-dies), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/mexicos-guadalajara-cartel-founder-dies-hospital-aged-80) reported that Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo, a founder of Mexico’s Guadalajara cartel known as the 'boss of bosses', died in a hospital on Sunday at the age of 80 after spending nearly four decades in prison.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/founder-of-guadalajara-cartel-dies-in-hospital-after-decades-in-prison?traffic_source=rss) reported that Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo was convicted of the 1985 murder of a US drug enforcement agent and a Mexican pilot.

[Jamaica Observer](https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/11/15/notorious-mexican-drug-lord-miguel-angel-felix-gallardo-dies/), [El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/muere-miguel-angel-felix-gallardo-el-jefe-de-jefes-fundador-del-cartel-de-guadalajara-33150574) reported that notorious Mexican drug lord Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo died at the age of 80 in a hospital in Guadalajara.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/muere-miguel-angel-felix-gallardo-el-jefe-de-jefes-fundador-del-cartel-de-guadalajara-fallece-a-los-80-anos/) reported that Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo was the founder of the Guadalajara Cartel and was serving a 77-year sentence for drug trafficking and the murder of DEA agent Enrique Camarena.
